_doc: Private rooms the EA answers in, beyond the main EA channel, keyed by the room id the chat gives: a Slack channel (C…, G…), a Zulip stream (stream:<id>) or a web chat room (r<n>). Two kinds, told apart by name. #ea-<project> (kind project): scoped to one project id from the project store; every thread in it is its own conversation with the project pack in hand, and the web board and App Home show the same #ea- badge. #tmp-<id8> (kind session): mirrors ONE Claude session (an ea-bot shell conversation, or a Slack thread promoted to a room); every message in it resumes that session. The bot writes this file itself when you say `open a channel for <project>` or `open a channel for session <uuid>` in chat (on Slack it needs the groups:write scope); register a hand-made channel with `python3 preprocessor/ea_channels.py register --channel <id> --project <id>`. The bot only scopes PRIVATE channels and answers only the owner in them.
